text.tspan: Phases: 1 isovolumic contraction; 2 ejection; 3 isovolumic relaxation; 4 filling (rapid, diastasis, atrial systole)
Valves: MC mitral closes; AO aortic opens; AC aortic closes; MO mitral opens

g.text: WIGGERS DIAGRAM OF ONE CARDIAC CYCLE (0.8 S, 75 BEATS/MIN). THE VENTRICLE EJECTS WHILE ITS PRESSURE

text.font-family: 'STIX Two Text', 'Times New Roman', Times, 'Liberation Serif', serif

g.text: EXCEEDS THE AORTIC, AND THE AORTIC VALVE CLOSING PRODUCES THE DICROTIC NOTCH
